title: Nettle
kicker: a frightened forest scout trying not to be seen
hook: a frightened forest scout trying not to be seen

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A young faun scout freezes with one hand raised, soft horns under a ragged hood, necklaces and leaf charms trembling against a patched vest.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Soft-hearted and quick-footed, frozen between flight and trust. Rubs a seed-charm from home whenever a choice sounds like betrayal either way. Wants to keep their people alive without learning to hate everyone outside the trees.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A way forward A grounded question A scene-specific clue seed
